title: Industry AI
tagline: Industry.ai: An autonomous Web3 agent agency where specialized AI agents collaborate seamlessly to automate complex tasks across DeFi, NFTs & more, all through natural conversation—no technical knowledge required.

prizes.title: Most Innovative Use of CDP SDK

description:
Industry.ai is a multi-agent orchestration platform that reinvents how we interact with Web3 technologies. At its core, it features four specialized AI agents that work together seamlessly to handle complex blockchain operations:

Eric - Our market analyst who studies crypto trends and provides trading insights
Harper - Our trading specialist who executes optimal trades and manages assets
Rishi - Our technical expert who handles smart contracts and infrastructure
Yasmin - Our creative lead who manages marketing and community engagement

What makes Industry.ai unique is how these agents collaborate autonomously through recursive chat systems. They can manage their own crypto wallets, coordinate complex tasks, and bridge the fragmented Web3 ecosystem - all while communicating in natural language with users.

A key aspect of Industry.ai is its modular tool system. Rather than tools being permanently tied to specific agents, they exist as independent modules that can be dynamically assigned to any agent through a simple drag-and-drop interface. This unprecedented flexibility allows organizations to customize their agent capabilities on the fly, optimizing workflows based on changing needs.

The platform integrates essential Web3 tools like Uniswap for trading, Zora for NFTs, and Coinbase Developer Platform for wallet creation. When a user makes a request, our intelligent routing system directs it to the appropriate agent who can either complete the task directly or coordinate with other agents for more complex operations.

What truly sets Industry.ai apart is its approach to platform integration through Natural Language Interfaces (NLI). We envision a future where platforms like Uniswap, Zora, and others develop official tools that serve as natural language interfaces to their services, completely replacing traditional APIs. This concept means that any functionality offered by these platforms becomes accessible through simple conversation in any language.

Imagine accessing Uniswap's full trading capabilities or Zora's complete NFT toolkit through natural conversation in Chinese, Spanish, or any other language - no programming knowledge required. This democratizes access to Web3 services on an unprecedented scale, allowing anyone, anywhere to leverage these powerful platforms through simple conversation with our agents.

For example, if you want to launch an NFT collection, our agents automatically handle everything from wallet creation and minting to metadata management and promotional content - no technical knowledge required.

By transforming complex Web3 operations into simple conversations, Industry.ai eliminates the need for users to manage private keys, write code, or navigate multiple platforms. It's the future of Web3 interaction, making blockchain technology accessible to everyone through natural language and autonomous agent coordination. The combination of our modular tool system and natural language interfaces creates a truly universal platform that breaks down both technical and language barriers in the Web3 space.
how_its_made:
Industry.ai is built on a robust technical foundation that combines modern AWS services with Web3 technologies. Here's how we pieced it together:

Core Infrastructure:
- Next.js powers our frontend, providing a fast and responsive user interface
- AWS Lambda with WebSocket API enables real-time chat functionality between users and agents
- AWS Bedrock serves as our AI foundation, running our specialized agents
- AWS Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework handles base intent routing and task distribution

Agent Architecture:
We built a custom recursive layer on top of the AWS Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework to enable sophisticated inter-agent communication. This allows our four specialized agents (Eric, Harper, Rishi, and Yasmin) to collaborate autonomously and handle complex multi-step operations.

Real-time Processing:
- WebSocket connections maintain persistent communication channels
- Lambda functions process messages and route intents to appropriate agents
- Our recursive layer enables agents to spawn sub-conversations with each other
- Titan Image Generator creates visual content for marketing and NFTs

Web3 Integration:
We've deeply integrated several partner technologies:
- Coinbase Developer Platform for secure wallet creation and management
- Uniswap for DeFi operations and liquidity analysis
- Zora for NFT minting and management

One particularly innovative aspect is our recursive chat system. When an agent needs assistance, they can initiate a sub-conversation with another agent, share context, and work together to complete complex tasks. This creates a dynamic, self-organizing system where agents can break down complex operations into manageable steps and collaborate effectively.

The combination of AWS's scalable infrastructure, real-time WebSocket communication, and our custom recursive layer enables Industry.ai to handle complex Web3 operations while maintaining natural, responsive interactions with users.
